_comment: Parameters for the dev stack (stock-news-dashboard-dev). scripts/deploy.py adds Environment, ReleaseId and OpsBucketName; the ALARM_EMAIL and SEC_USER_AGENT environment variables (GitHub variables in CI) override AlarmEmail and SecUserAgent.
_modelProfileComment: Models come from infra/models.json. 'haiku-4-5' is the interim profile while the account only has Claude Haiku 4.5; switch to 'target' (Claude Sonnet 5.5 writer, Claude Haiku 5.5 judge) once check-models passes for it.
